commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Dethrone and counter-seeding protect creatures before sacrifice; Marchesa returns them next end step, enabling ETB/death value and persist resets.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 Optimized because creature, +1 counter, sacrifice and delayed end step dependencies are powerful but meaningfully interruptible.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Reject generic tax-draw and cEDH combo substitutions that discard Marchesa's counter-dependent ETB death loop identity.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: The October 19 M6 source has each of the 99 card roles individually annotated, reviewed anew for seven concrete cuts and additional rejected slots; main core protected.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Retains exactly 34 lands and all six nonland rocks, no new utility colorless lands; four-mana RR Curse-Marred Demon is harder to cast than Braids, while other creature replacements lower the top curve.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Keeps Flare of Denial, Fierce Guardianship, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, sac outlets, Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act; Withering Torment improves enchantment interaction but costs one extra mana.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: The locked October 15 100 was heavily tuned with 21 prior improvements, all altars, counter enablers and compact persist/undying kills retained.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: Reviewed 99 card roles, original M6 129 challenger screens and EDHREC 260 vectors, full October 2026 names, seven selected and eight rejected candidate judgments, plus complete 8/9 alternatives.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: The Ooze and Madame Null are off-inherited-rank commander-specific resources; Curse-Marred Demon adds recurring tutor value after October 2026 Reality Fracture.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Off-ranking review identified The Ooze, Madame Null and October 2026 Curse-Marred Demon beyond inherited M5 rankings, plus Spymaster's Vault and Lazotep Quarry lands.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Grim Haruspex is a commander-recurring creature keyed to repeated sacrifice deaths, while Rhystic shifts pressure toward generic tax draw.
Five mana for Dictate delays the same engine and generic Rhystic compromises commander-driven draw, increasing high-curve exposure.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Preserved Flayer of the Hatebound, Gray Merchant, Mikaeus, the Ozolith and all main sacrifice outlets after explicit source-driven review of their combo roles.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The preexisting high-cost card advantage and one-shot Deadly Dispute crowd out lower-curve engines that improve Marchesa's counter safety and ETB looping.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Seven exact replacements retain the proven mana base and persist finishes while strengthening counter-entry, sacrifice and recurring tutoring; the full eight/nine options lose identity.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: All incumbent card roles were revisited against original M6 detailed 99-slot audit, recent EDHREC commander filters and current Scryfall release discoveries. Seven selected swaps were followed by two additional challenges and two complete higher-count replacement packages. No padding was added for a numeric threshold.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Rhystic is universally powerful tax draw, but removing Grim loses an inexpensive recurring Marchesa creature and rewards less of the dedicated free-sacrifice plan.
Dictate can flash in and reduces black-pip pressure but costs five instead of four and increases curve exposure without adding a new sacrifice axis.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A high-output generic draw enchantment may see more cards against spell-heavy pods than a dying-creature draw source.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Grim Haruspex is a commander-recurring creature keyed to repeated sacrifice deaths, while Rhystic shifts pressure toward generic tax draw.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Adds broader untargeted draw and flash sacrifice pressure with easier black pips for Grave Pact's replacement.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Five mana for Dictate delays the same engine and generic Rhystic compromises commander-driven draw, increasing high-curve exposure.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The two completed higher-swap portfolios trade away on-theme death-trigger draw for a generic tax enchantment and/or increase mana value in an already black-heavy grave pact role. Earlier retained Flayer and Gray Merchant participate in real compact wins. More swaps can be written but have less Marchesa-specific upside than their incumbent opportunity costs.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: The exact source has 100 physical cards, 98 distinct names, Island x2 and Swamp x2 only repeats, 34 lands, one Marchesa commander, seven balanced additions/cuts.
